events.title: Here Comes Santa Claus
events.addr: 1st Ave SW & 2nd St SW, Rochester, MN 55902
events.blurb: Downtown's 52nd annual Santa kickoff: Mrs. Claus' Workshop with Nutcracker performances at the Historic Chateau Theatre (2:30–4:45 p.m.), Santa's rescue at Old City Hall at 5, the Peace Plaza tree lighting at 5:15, then photos with Santa at the Galleria until 7.
events.blurbEs: La 52.ª llegada anual de Santa al centro: el Taller de Mrs. Claus con funciones de El Cascanueces en el Historic Chateau Theatre (2:30–4:45 p. m.), el rescate de Santa en Old City Hall a las 5, el encendido del árbol en Peace Plaza a las 5:15 y fotos con Santa en la Galleria hasta las 7.

events.title: The Wizards of Winter
events.addr: 30 Civic Center Dr SE, Rochester, MN 55904
events.blurb: A holiday rock-opera concert that gives familiar Christmas music a rock treatment.
events.blurbEs: Un concierto navideño de rock-ópera que lleva la música de Navidad conocida al rock.

events.title: Festival of Trees
events.addr: The Kahler Grand Hotel, Rochester, MN
events.blurb: Hiawatha Homes' 41st Festival of Trees fills the Kahler Grand with decorated holiday trees; general viewing runs Friday through Sunday and supports people with disabilities.
events.blurbEs: El 41.º Festival of Trees de Hiawatha Homes llena el Kahler Grand de árboles navideños decorados; la exhibición general es de viernes a domingo y apoya a personas con discapacidad.

events.title: Rochester Art Center
events.addr: 30 Civic Center Dr SE, Suite 120, Rochester, MN 55904
events.blurb: Contemporary art downtown, with current shows including Forms of Care: The Art of Representing the Body and Roger Wardin's Painting a Parallel World. Visitors 21 and under get in free.
events.blurbEs: Arte contemporáneo en el centro, con exposiciones como Forms of Care: The Art of Representing the Body y Painting a Parallel World de Roger Wardin. La entrada es gratis para menores de 22 años.

events.title: Quarry Hill Park & Nature Center
events.addr: 701 Silver Creek Rd NE, Rochester, MN 55906
events.blurb: Free trails, caves and a nature center; the park is open dawn to dusk and the free nature center is open Fri–Sat 9 a.m.–4 p.m. and Sun noon–4 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Senderos gratuitos, cuevas y un centro de naturaleza; el parque abre del amanecer al anochecer y el centro de naturaleza, también gratis, abre vie–sáb de 9 a. m. a 4 p. m. y dom de mediodía a 4 p. m.
